go_semantics: Both trees declare go 1.22 in go.mod. The labels assume Go 1.22 language semantics and standard library, built by a Go 1.22 or later toolchain with this module as the main module. The required module example.test/platform is not present, so neither tree builds; that missing context is the point of the case.

false_positive_traps.wrong_finding: A verified finding that the swapped call now retries 200 times with a 5 ms backoff, or that the base order was the bug.
false_positive_traps.why_wrong: Either claim needs the signature of `retry.Do`, which is not in the reviewed source; only an inconclusive or abstaining outcome is supported by the evidence.

abstention_reason: `retry.Do` belongs to the module `example.test/platform`, whose source is in neither tree. Whether its second parameter is the attempt count or the backoff decides whether the head introduces a bug or fixes one, and the diff cannot show which.
